meta.note: All prices are ESTIMATES. Children prices apply to ages 3-13 in most cases. Family prices show 2 adults + 2 children. Always check official websites for current pricing and pre-book online to save (gate prices are typically higher).

attractions.name: Dreamworld
attractions.description: Australia's favourite theme park — big thrill rides, family coasters, DreamWorks kids' area, Tiger Island, native animal exhibits, WhiteWater World waterpark next door.
attractions.note: Online prices shown. Gate prices ~$10 more. Combo tickets with WhiteWater World available. RACQ/NRMA member discounts often available.

attractions.name: WhiteWater World
attractions.description: Adjoining waterpark to Dreamworld — waterslides, wave pool, lazy river, kids splash zone. Perfect for hot Queensland days. Buy as combo or with Dreamworld pass.
attractions.note: Combo Dreamworld+WhiteWater = better value if doing both. Bring sunscreen and rashies.

attractions.name: Warner Bros. Movie World
attractions.description: Hollywood on the Gold Coast — DC Rivals HyperCoaster, Justice League 3D ride, Looney Tunes kids zone, stunt shows, character meet-and-greets. Fantastic for kids who love superheroes and movies.
attractions.note: Village Roadshow pass covers Movie World + Sea World + Wet'n'Wild + Paradise Country. 3-day pass ~$169 adult/$129 child.

attractions.name: Sea World
attractions.description: Marine theme park — dolphin shows, penguin exhibit, polar bear shores, Nickelodeon kids zone, jellyfish exhibit, rides including Storm Coaster. Strong educational value with animal presentations.
attractions.note: Included in Village Roadshow 3/5/7-day passes. Monorail from outside park. Combine with Sea World Resort stay.

attractions.name: Wet'n'Wild Gold Coast
attractions.description: Giant waterpark — extreme waterslides (Kamikaze, Tornado), Calypso Beach lazy river, Giant Wave Pool, Buccaneer Bay kids area with mini slides and splash zones. Fantastic on a hot day.
attractions.note: Part of Village Roadshow multi-park pass. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, hats, and water shoes. Lockers available ($).

attractions.name: Paradise Country
attractions.description: Farm experience — sheep shearing shows, stock horse shows, koala and kangaroo encounters, billy tea and damper, farm animal nursery. Hands-on Australian farm experience perfect for younger families.
attractions.note: Included in Village Roadshow multi-park passes. Animal add-on experiences extra (koala photo, etc.).

attractions.name: Topgolf Gold Coast
attractions.description: High-tech driving range meets entertainment — climate-controlled hitting bays, point-scoring games, food and drinks delivered to your bay. Fun for the whole family, no golf experience needed.
attractions.note: Prices are per person per hour. Food/drink not included. Booking recommended weekends. Near Movie World.

attractions.name: Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary
attractions.description: Iconic wildlife sanctuary — free-roaming kangaroos, koala cuddling (extra), wild lorikeet feeding, crocodile show, Lost Valley rainforest walk, TreeTops Challenge (extra), Segway tours. Classic Australian wildlife experience.
attractions.note: Family passes for 2 adults + 3 children available. Koala experience extra (~$30). Lorikeet feeding free with entry. Bring insect repellent.

attractions.name: SkyPoint Observation Deck
attractions.description: 360-degree views from level 77 of the Q1 building, 230m above sea level — Australia's highest observation deck. Spot the entire coastline, see theme parks, hinterland. Bistro and bar at the top. Great morning coffee spot.
attractions.note: SkyPoint Climb (external walk) extra (~$90 adult outdoor climb) — separate booking, not for kids under 12.

attractions.name: Infinity Attraction
attractions.description: Mind-bending walk-through attraction — 20 multi-sensory environments with special effects, illusions, soundscapes and futuristic mazes. Dark, trippy, kids love it. Unique experience, nothing else like it on the Coast.
attractions.note: Can be dark and loud — judge for sensitive kids. Family pass 2+2 = $88. Central Surfers, walk from tram.

attractions.name: Jetboat Extreme
attractions.description: High-speed jetboat ride through the Broadwater — 360-degree spins, power slides, get soaked. Great family adrenaline rush. Multiple operators from Surfers — 55-min tours, full commentary, see millionaire mansions, marine life.
attractions.note: You WILL get wet — bring a change of clothes for after. Life jackets provided. Minimum height restrictions apply.

attractions.name: Gold Coast Whale Watching (Jun–Oct)
attractions.description: Seasonal humpback whale tours departing Surfers Paradise or Main Beach. See whales breach, tail-slap, and spy-hop during the annual migration. Guaranteed sightings or free return cruise.
attractions.note: SEASONAL: June-October only. Book ahead in peak (Sept). Motion sickness tablets recommended. Morning cruises calmer water.

attractions.name: Family Surf Lesson (2hrs)
attractions.description: Learn to surf on the Gold Coast's famous waves — gentle beach breaks, qualified instructors, all equipment provided (soft beginner boards, rash shirts, sunscreen). Standing-up guarantee. Multiple surf schools at The Spit or Coolangatta.
attractions.note: Private family group lessons available. Check tide times — mid-tide best for beginners. Rain runs as normal. Bring swimmers and towel.

attractions.name: Tamborine Rainforest Skywalk
attractions.description: Walk through the canopy of a subtropical rainforest on a steel-structured skywalk — 300m of bridges, 40m above the creek, plus a cantilever lookout with stunning views. Glow worm cave nearby (extra). Tamborine Mountain galleries and cafes.
attractions.note: Easy walking, pram-friendly. Combine with Gallery Walk (free artisan shops) and Curtis Falls walking track (free, ~45min round trip). About 40min drive from Surfers.

attractions.name: Surfers Paradise Beach
attractions.description: Australia's most famous beach — 3km of golden sand, patrolled swimming areas, beach volleyball, foreshore markets (Wed/Fri/Sun evenings). The ultimate free family activity: sandcastles, swimming, sunsets. Walk to everything.
attractions.note: Swim between the flags ONLY. Free parking hard to find — paid beachfront parking or tram in.

attractions.name: Burleigh Head National Park Walk
attractions.description: Stunning coastal headland walk — 2.3km circuit (easy, 1hr), ocean views, rainforest track, Tallebudgera Creek at the end (calm swimming for kids), spot whales offshore in season. Free BBQ areas. A Gold Coast rite of passage.
attractions.note: Free parking but busy on weekends — go early. Pack swimmers and picnic — Tallebudgera Creek is perfect kid swimming.

attractions.name: Broadwater Parklands
attractions.description: Massive free waterfront park — giant jumping pillow, flying fox, water play area (Rockpools), playgrounds, BBQ areas, bike paths, calm swimming in the Broadwater (enclosed swimming area). The best free family day out on the Coast.
attractions.note: Pack a picnic and swimmers. Rockpools water play is free and excellent. Australia Fair shopping + Chinatown nearby.

attractions.name: Pacific Fair Shopping Centre
attractions.description: Queensland's largest shopping centre — 400+ stores across indoor-outdoor resort-style layout, massive food court, luxury brands, department stores, family rest areas, kids play zones, events. Good rainy-day activity.
attractions.note: Free entry, free parking. Great for a half-day on a rainy or extra-hot day. The new food precinct is excellent.

attractions.name: Timezone Surfers Paradise
attractions.description: Massive arcade in the heart of Surfers — racing simulators, Mario Kart, basketball shooting, prize claw machines, VR experiences (extra), bowling, laser tag. Fun for rainy afternoons or evening family competition.
attractions.note: Pay-as-you-go with loaded game card. Budget ~$25pp for a good session. VR and bowling cost extra.

attractions.name: Putt Putt Mermaid Beach
attractions.description: Three themed 18-hole mini-golf courses — Jungle Trail, Waterways, Fun Run. Classic family mini-golf, well-maintained, fun for all ages. Easy walk-up, no booking needed, open evenings. An institution since 1965.
attractions.note: Family pass (2+2) = $56. Open until 10pm most nights — great evening activity after dinner.

attractions.name: iFLY Indoor Skydiving
attractions.description: Indoor skydiving in a vertical wind tunnel — float on a cushion of air, feel the sensation of freefall with no jumping out of a plane. Safe, fully supervised, two flights per person, from age 3+. Next to Timezone in Surfers.
attractions.note: Prices for 2-flight intro package. Book ahead online for best price. Family of 4 package sometimes $299.

attractions.name: Aquaduck Gold Coast
attractions.description: Amphibious vehicle tour — drive through Surfers Paradise streets, then splash straight into the Broadwater for a boat cruise. Kids get to steer and get a Captain's certificate. Quirky, iconic Gold Coast experience.
attractions.note: Family pass (2+2) = $149. Book ahead — popular with young families. Kids love the 'splashdown' moment.

attractions.name: Springbrook Glow Worm Caves (night tour)
attractions.description: Natural Bridge at Springbrook National Park — walk through ancient rainforest to a waterfall cave filled with thousands of glow worms at night. Magical, free, unforgettable. Peer into a collapsed cave with waterfall, then stay after dark for the glow worms.
attractions.note: Free but requires driving (~45min from Surfers). Easy 1km circuit. Go at dusk — return after dark. Bring torches (red light preferred), jackets, insect repellent. No facilities at the site.

attractions.name: Snapper Rocks / Rainbow Bay
attractions.description: World-famous surf break with a protected family swimming area — Rainbow Bay is a gentle, patrolled beach perfect for young kids. Snapper Rocks has a natural rock pool at low tide for exploring sea life. Greenmount walk has incredible coastal views.
attractions.note: Free but limited parking — arrive early. Rainbow Bay Surf Club has good family meals with a view. Walk to Point Danger lighthouse (QLD/NSW border).

attractions.name: Gallery Walk — Tamborine Mountain
attractions.description: Charming mountain village shopping street — artisan galleries, fudge shops, German cuckoo-clock store, distillery, cute cafes. Cool mountain air, beautiful drive up. Combine with Rainforest Skywalk or Curtis Falls for a full mountain day.
attractions.note: Free entry (shopping not). Parking can be tight on weekends. Combine with Skywalk or glow worm caves. 40 min drive from Surfers.

attractions.name: Currumbin Rock Pools
attractions.description: Natural freshwater swimming holes in Currumbin Valley — crystal-clear mountain water, smooth rock slides created by nature, rope swings, shaded by eucalypts. Free, beautiful, and a true local secret. Bring a picnic and stay the afternoon.
attractions.note: Free but ~35min drive from central GC. No facilities — BYO everything. Water shoes recommended (rocks can be slippery). Check Currumbin Valley weather before going.

attractions.name: Breakfast with the Stars (Movie World)
attractions.description: Buffet breakfast at Movie World with Looney Tunes characters — Bugs Bunny, Tweety, Daffy Duck, Scooby-Doo visit each table for photos and autographs. Kids' pancake station, hot buffet, coffee. Park entry separate or included with pass.
attractions.note: Booking essential — very popular. Price is for breakfast only (park entry extra or via Annual Pass).

attractions.name: Tallebudgera Creek
attractions.description: Calm, crystal-clear tidal creek — perfect for young kids and non-swimmers. Protected swimming area with gentle water, sandy beach, shaded picnic areas, BBQ facilities. Between Burleigh Headland and Palm Beach. Safe, beautiful, and free.
attractions.note: Free parking but limited — go early on weekends. Tallebudgera Surf Club adjacent for lunch with a view. No waves = stress-free for parents of toddlers.

attractions.name: Miami Marketta
attractions.description: Vibrant night food market — 25+ street food vendors (tacos, bao, dumplings, burgers, ramen, gelato), live music, fairy lights, communal seating. Friday/Saturday nights only. Incredible atmosphere, family-friendly early evening, live music builds later.
attractions.note: $3 entry per adult, kids free. Food from ~$10-18 per dish. Go at 5-6pm for family atmosphere. Live music from 7pm. Cash and card.
